representation: Price-quantity axes with a fixed downward-sloping demand line and an upward-sloping supply line whose horizontal position is controlled by a slider. A dashed ghost supply line marks the original position.
motion: Moving the supply slider shifts the green supply line; the equilibrium dot slides along the fixed demand line, and the dashed guides follow it.
controls: slider for supply shift from -2 to +2 units
checkpoints: curve shift versus movement along a curve
misconceptionTest: The demand curve stays fixed when supply shifts, so a price change is not what shifted demand. The moving equilibrium shows a change in quantity demanded, not a demand shift. Equilibrium is a balance of plans, not a promise that everyone can buy at any price.
accessibility: Alt text, labeled axes and curves, keyboard slider, high-contrast equilibrium dot, and dashed guides that are also described in text.
